experiment: SCNA FP16 d8 progressive optimization on Hexagon v79

fixed_contract.scna: FP16 direct, SCOPE frozen d8 coefficients
fixed_contract.attention_dataflow: identical QK, PV, mask, K/V load and tiling code across variants

variants.only_change: Clean reconstruction of unoptimized stage-one SCNA: runtime width, sequential rows, repeated coefficient lookup/conversion, qf16 multiply/add/convert, one worker.
variants.hypothesis: Establish the vertical baseline and quantify SCNA hot-path cost.

variants.only_change: Prepare and pack d8 coefficient bits once before Attention worker submission; row evaluation remains sequential, dynamic-width qf16.
variants.hypothesis: Remove repeated table lookup and fp16-float-fp16 conversion from each row.

variants.only_change: Evaluate row0/row1 together so one w/b load and splat feeds both independent qf16 chains.
variants.hypothesis: Reduce duplicate coefficient load/splat work; register pressure may offset the gain.

variants.only_change: Replace runtime-width paired loop with compile-time d8 and unroll it.
variants.hypothesis: Remove width-loop control and expose scheduling; code size and pressure may increase.

variants.only_change: Replace qf16 multiply/add/convert chain with IEEE FP16 vmpyacc, vmax and vadd; body is noinline.
variants.hypothesis: Shorten the dependent arithmetic chain while retaining an isolation call boundary.

variants.only_change: Apply always_inline to the otherwise identical static d8 FP16 FMA pair body.
variants.hypothesis: Remove call/return overhead; expanded live ranges may increase stack or spills.

variants.only_change: Use the preregistered inline/noinline selection rule and enable capped multi-worker scheduling.
variants.hypothesis: Distribute q=32's 16 query-block/KV-head tasks across available HVX contexts within the VTCM cap.

inline_selection.metric: single-worker DSP total geometric mean over all qo_len
inline_selection.tie_rule: Choose noinline when difference is below 1% or paired-bootstrap 95% CI crosses 1.0x.
